SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-11: CQL — Arithmetic Operators Part 2. Test these items: Maximum, Minimum, Modulo, Multiply, Negate, Precision, Predecessor, Power, Round, Subtract, Successor, Truncate, TruncatedDivide. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Appendix B Arithmetic Operators intro + Successor/Predecessor: overflow beyond the type's representable range yields null, not an out-of-type value
issues.evidence: translate+execute `successor of Coalesce({2147483647})` -> 2147483648 and `predecessor of Coalesce({-2147483648})` -> -2147483649 on BOTH native cpp and Python fallback; Long/Decimal/temporal boundaries correctly return null. Prior CQL-11 EXPLORER fix only guards literal operands; statically Integer non-literal operands pass through the BIGINT helper which clamps only at Long bounds.
issues.root_cause: Translator: _infer_static_numeric_type extended to Coalesce; successor/predecessor emit CASE boundary guard for statically Integer non-literal operands (_operators.py)
issues.resolution: Translator: _infer_static_numeric_type extended to Coalesce; successor/predecessor emit CASE boundary guard for statically Integer non-literal operands (_operators.py)

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Negate (Integer overload) + Duration Between (returns Integer): negating an Integer-valued duration result is valid CQL
issues.evidence: `-(days between @2024-01-01 and @2024-01-10)` translates to `- cqlDurationBetween(...)`; cqlDurationBetween returns VARCHAR so DuckDB binder fails: "No function matches -(VARCHAR)" on both engines. Binary + routes through cqlUncertainAdd, unary minus has no such normalization.
issues.root_cause: Translator: unary minus wraps cqlDurationBetween/cqlDifferenceBetween operands in TRY_CAST(... AS BIGINT) before prefix minus (_operators.py)
issues.resolution: Translator: unary minus wraps cqlDurationBetween/cqlDifferenceBetween operands in TRY_CAST(... AS BIGINT) before prefix minus (_operators.py)

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Negate: "When negating quantities, the unit is unchanged"; dual-engine lockstep rule
issues.evidence: `-(3 days)` -> Python fallback JSON unit/code 'day', native cpp 'd' (pint round-trip in Python quantityNegate normalizes the calendar keyword to UCUM).
issues.root_cause: Python fallback quantityNegate no longer round-trips pint; negates value and preserves unit verbatim, JSON key order aligned to native (udf/quantity.py)
issues.resolution: Python fallback quantityNegate no longer round-trips pint; negates value and preserves unit verbatim, JSON key order aligned to native (udf/quantity.py)

issues.spec_citation: CQL grammar: a well-formed expression consumes the entire input
issues.evidence: parse_expression("successor of T05:30") silently returns Identifier('T05') ignoring ':30' trailing tokens; parse_cql correctly rejects.
issues.root_cause: parse_expression now raises ParseError on trailing tokens (parser.py)
issues.resolution: parse_expression now raises ParseError on trailing tokens (parser.py)
